fly_side.prompt: Flies in place, beating its wings up and down in strong steady strokes, its body rising a little on each downstroke. It stays in place, facing right.

fly_down.prompt: Flies in place, beating its wings up and down in strong steady strokes, its body rising a little on each downstroke. It stays in place, facing the viewer the whole time.

fly_up.prompt: Flies in place, beating its wings up and down in strong steady strokes, its body rising a little on each downstroke. It stays in place with its back to the viewer the whole time.

swoop_side.prompt: Darts forward with its wings swept back and snaps its toothy jaws, then flaps back up. It stays in place, facing right.

swoop_down.prompt: Darts forward with its wings swept back and snaps its toothy jaws, then flaps back up. It stays in place, facing the viewer the whole time.

swoop_up.prompt: Darts forward with its wings swept back and snaps its toothy jaws, then flaps back up. It stays in place with its back to the viewer the whole time.

hurt_side.prompt: Flinches: jerks its head and body back, then returns to its stance. It stays in place, facing right.

hurt_down.prompt: Flinches: jerks its head and body back, then returns to its stance. It stays in place, facing the viewer the whole time.

hurt_up.prompt: Flinches: jerks its head and body back, then returns to its stance. It stays in place with its back to the viewer the whole time.

death_side.prompt: Folds its wings and tumbles down out of the air, falling onto its side, then lies still. It stays in place, facing right.

death_down.prompt: Folds its wings and tumbles down out of the air, falling onto its side, then lies still. It stays in place, facing the viewer the whole time.

death_up.prompt: Folds its wings and tumbles down out of the air, falling onto its side, then lies still. It stays in place with its back to the viewer the whole time.
